title: Joules per Decision: Measuring the Energy Cost of LLM Agents in Network Operations — measurement code and results
description:
Measurement code, per-task result files, and analysis scripts accompanying the paper Joules per Decision: Measuring the Energy Cost of LLM Agents in Network Operations.

GPU board power is sampled at 10 Hz with a streaming nvidia-smi process and integrated over wall-clock time, net of a per-cell idle baseline, while four Qwen2.5 sizes perform subnet arithmetic, ACL rule evaluation, and BGP best-path selection, on a datacenter accelerator and an edge-class card, and on the NetArena benchmark. The deposit includes the power sampler, the task generator and its grading function, the independent ground-truth re-derivation, the grading-rule audit, the statistical analyses, and the figure-generation code.

All energy figures are GPU board power only; host, power-supply, cooling, and facility overheads are outside the instrument.
